title: Grid Commissioning
summary: After the first generator and battery are online, scan, mark, and document the grid before scaling.
body: Use Lens on a PowerGrid node, open the Power Grid Terminal tab, and place HoloMap markers for the Factory Substation anchor, high-voltage trunk, and Field Battery room. The goal is a readable factory path, not a larger content wave.
steps: Scan a generator, high-voltage cable, Field Battery Bank, or Factory Substation with Lens.
Open the Power Grid Terminal tab and follow the next-step line.
Place HoloMap markers for factory_substation_anchor, high_voltage_trunk, and field_battery_room.
Finish the Grid Commissioning mission before adding more machine rows.
commonMistakes: Treating high-voltage cable as decoration instead of a marked route.
Skipping Field Battery reserve before the first heavy processor.
Leaving custom component recipes undocumented in Index.
